## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Checklist

- [ ] This change has one clear purpose.
- [ ] Relevant skill behavior is updated.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where necessary.
- [ ] The plugin manifest is updated if a skill was added or removed.
- [ ] `scripts/validate-skills.sh` passes.
- [ ] No confidential or company-specific information is included.
